hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/fowlers-hollow-state-park/stay ('Twelve campsites with electric hookups') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880321 (all 11 Rustic Electric sites list 30-amp; no site lists water or sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: twelve campsites with electric hookups and six walk-in tent sites; the booking site lists 11 drive-in Rustic Electric sites (sites 1-12 are electric, one presumably the host site) and 6 walk-to tent sites. Listed max vehicle lengths on the electric sites run 20-50 ft (two at 50, two at 40); all are back-in.

values.note: Campsites (Rustic Electric, Rustic Tent) can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (late March to mid-December) already manual and restated by DCNR. Added 30-amp electric, 18 campsites (11-12 electric, back-in up to 50 ft; 6 walk-in tent), flush toilets/water spigot/dump and no showers. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront' (waterfront_evidence: DCNR map shows Fowler Hollow Run along the south edge separated from the pads by the loop road, picnic/dump area and a riparian treeline), but ReserveAmerica tags all 11 Rustic Electric RV sites (and the 6 tent sites) 'Waterfront: Waterfront' for parkId 880321. A booking-engine tag decides nothing; the existing evidence may well stand, but the contrary claim triggers the gate.
